contentList.content: A Dragon Nest Warrior, a powerful melee combatant who masters both physical and magical sword techniques.
An Intelligence-based sword mage who channels moonlight into devastating blade techniques and radiant beam attacks.
Grants Light Armor and Medium Armor proficiency.
Grants sword techniques and scholarly discipline.
Strike with a swift empowered punch as a Bonus Action. This attack uses unarmed melee scaling and gains extra damage rolls at levels 5 and 9.
A Moonlord resource equal to Intelligence modifier multiplied by class level. Replenishes on Long Rest.
Technical passive used by Script Extender to calculate Dragon Force.
Ward yourself against weapon blows for 3 turns. Costs 1 Dragon Force and uses a Bonus Action.
A Moonlord combat resource. Maximum 6 at levels 1-4, 8 at levels 5-8, and 10 at level 9+. Refills to full when combat starts and resets after combat.
Technical passive used by Script Extender to manage Magic Energy.
Release a narrow shockwave with your weapon. Creatures in the wave make a Dexterity save, taking weapon damage on a failed save. Costs 1 Battle Exertion.
Martial exertion used for advanced combat actions. Maximum equals proficiency bonus plus subclass spellcasting ability modifier. Refills to full when combat starts.
Technical passive used by Script Extender to manage Battle Exertion.
Launch 3 moonlight slashes. Each slash makes its own attack roll and deals weapon damage. Damage scales to 2 weapon rolls at level 5 and 3 weapon rolls at level 9. Costs 1 Battle Exertion.
Moonlight Splitter accuracy penalty: -3 at levels 1-4, -2 at levels 5-8, and -1 at level 9+.
A precise martial striker that relies on dexterity, stealth, and surgical timing.
A weaponless assassin path that channels grim force through body control and disciplined will.
Technical passive used by Script Extender to calculate Dragon Force for Reaper.
Technical passive used by Script Extender to manage Battle Exertion for Reaper.
Launch a razor-thin piercing wave in a straight line. Uses unarmed attack scaling, costs 1 Battle Exertion, and gains extra damage rolls at levels 5 and 9.
Strike the same target with a rapid 3-hit melee barrage. Costs 1 Battle Exertion and scales at levels 5 and 9.
